findings.title: Health system closes National Landing urgent care, West Springfield primary care location
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Health system closes National Landing urgent care, West Springfield primary care location
findings.access_consequences: VHC Health's West Springfield primary care location has closed. The source preview identifies a separate National Landing urgent-care closure while noting primary care remains at National Landing. Exact closure dates, alternative arrangements and number of patients affected could not be verified from available article text.
findings.affected_population: Patients using the West Springfield VHC primary care location; number unknown.
